narration: You just got a $6,900 hospital bill and it feels like a final number. Here's the thing — it was never final to begin with.
visual: Hospital bill document SVG with $6,900 counter animating up. A blue 'NEGOTIABLE' stamp appears rotated over the bill. Dark background with blue radial gradient.

narration: Number one: eighty percent of medical bills have at least one billing error. The average mistake quietly adds $1,300 to what you owe.
visual: Light background. A bill with 5 line items; red warning circles appear on 3 of them one by one with exclamation marks. '$1,300 avg error' counter springs in at the bottom.

narration: Number two: hospitals are legally required to offer charity care programs — but only to patients who ask. And most people never do.
visual: Dark background. Hospital building SVG with a cross sign on the roof. A person silhouette walks toward the door. A speech bubble appears: 'Can I apply for financial assistance?'

narration: Number three: always demand the itemized bill. Hospitals charge $47 for a Tylenol and $286 for a toothbrush — the breakdown exposes everything.
visual: Light background. Itemized bill SVG with pill icon labeled $47, toothbrush labeled $286, bandage labeled $129 — each line item reveals one by one with accent highlight.

narration: Negotiating saves an average of thirty to forty percent. On a $6,900 bill, that's $2,400 back — without a lawyer and without a fight.
visual: Dark background. Two animated bars growing up side by side: 'No Ask' in red at $6,900, 'Negotiated' in blue at $4,500. '$2,400 saved' springs in below.

narration: Before you pay any medical bill, call and ask for the itemized list, then ask what they can do about the balance. That one call is worth $2,400.
visual: Light background. Phone SVG with a call animation, arrow pointing to piggy bank with coins falling in. Bold text 'ASK. EVERY. TIME.' springs in at the bottom.
